professionalSummary: Associate‑grade Quantitative Analyst with three years of experience in a retail bank’s model validation function, performing validation testing on credit risk models under the bank’s documented validation standard.
Drafted findings sections and open items lists for validation reports, maintained review boundary sections, and updated the validation testing template following the 2024 standard update.
Participated in model risk committee meetings alongside the reviewer of record for four validations.
Previously worked as a graduate analyst in a consultancy’s risk practice for one year.
experienceHighlights: Performed validation testing on eleven credit risk model validations, including replication of model estimates, benchmark model comparison, and stability testing, with test workbooks filed in the validation repository.
Drafted findings sections and open items lists for validation reports; the reviewer of record edited and signed the reports.
Attended model risk committee meetings with the reviewer of record for four validations.
Maintained the review boundary section of each report and updated the validation function’s testing template after the 2024 standard update.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: test workbook and drafted findings section for one credit risk model validation, with validation repository references as a verification trail; the signed report carries the reviewer of record’s signature.
skills: Validation testing (replication, benchmark comparison, stability testing)
Documentation of findings and open items
